protocol: cross-modal claim->diagram_node retrieval; query-prefix register gap vs Procrustes bridge (G0 doc-doc / G1 prefix-doc / G2 prefix+procrustes)

pool.same_doc: ID-reachable nodes (normalized text == some same-doc requirement title)

notes: no diagram node text contains a regex identifier (verified at run time: n_nodes_with_regex_id in data_audit); the spec's claim-ID<->node-ID gold link is realized as the deterministic chain: claim canonical ID -> requirements.jsonl row (requirement_id or canonical raw_text ID match) -> title -> same-doc snapshot node with whitespace-normalized equal text
IDs are extracted whitespace-tolerantly and canonicalized; hierarchical parent IDs that are hyphen-prefixes of another ID in the same claim are dropped (tree-table rows resolve to the deepest ID)
candidate pool adapts '含ID node': same-doc pool = ID-reachable nodes (superset of gold), negatives = seeded sample of other docs' ID-reachable nodes; per-query RNG is seeded by (seed, sha1(claim id))

query text = features.jsonl text (the exact string the snapshot vectors encode; 8 claim texts are 200-char snapshot-truncated, counted in data_audit.claim_mismatch.text); ID extraction uses claim_slot_features raw_text
Recall@k is hit-style (query counts when any gold node ranks in top-k); MRR@10 uses the first gold's rank; AUC pools all (query, pool-node) score/label pairs
G1 equals the deployed O1 retrieval protocol (query prefix + bare doc); G2 fits prefix->doc orthogonal Procrustes on train anchors with anchor_ids = claim occurrence ids
dev-fold gold claims are excluded from anchors and queries
